items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: There's a difference between Claude Hopkins and Claude Thornhill, who comes later in my life.

ctx.x: And as I said at this time there was Waller, Cab Calloway, Duke Ellington, Claude Hopkins. There's a difference between Claude Hopkins and Claude Thornhill, who comes later in my life. But they were all of these great musicians who looked up to and you admired

and you could learn from them. And they were mostly not only great and fine musicians, but believe it or not, even in those days most of these men were very intelligent type of people, clean cut people, well disciplined, well liked, dressed neat and had thousands of admirers. Because of their personal habits, which they didn't over exert themselves in these ways of, you know, deterioration of habits, you know.
